name: Devour
source:
Your mom sends you off to collect some mushrooms from the local forest with the usual warning: “Be careful of Devourers!” Not that anything exciting like that could ever happen to you.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
媽媽打發你去附近的森林採些蘑菇，照例叮囑你：「小心吞噬者！」不過，這麼刺激的事怎麼可能讓你碰上呢。

［摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian App[/url]］
